text: After this you can calculate simple insulation values and distinguish conduction from air leakage.

Walls, roofs, openings, and glazing influence the heat transferred through a building boundary. Thermal resistance R opposes heat flow; matching thermal transmittance U equals 1/R. Series-layer resistances add when the assumptions and units are appropriate. Heat flow also depends on area and temperature difference. Infiltration is air entering through unintended gaps, a different mechanism from conduction. Simple R-value arithmetic does not fully represent glazing or thermal mass.
